units.source_text: 当然了，这种工业上的奇迹不单单出现在书籍制造公司，也出现在绘画制造公司和音乐制造公司。

en.t: Of course, this kind of industrial miracle appeared not only in book manufacturing companies, but also in painting manufacturing companies and music manufacturing companies.

units.source_text: 听嘎尔讲，这个国家平均一个月就有七八百种新机器发明出来，一切都可以不靠人工而大规模生产出来，

en.t: According to Gael, in this country an average of seven or eight hundred new kinds of machines are invented each month, and everything can be mass-produced without relying on human labor,

units.source_text: 因此失业的河童职工也超过了四五万只。

en.t: As a result, the number of unemployed kappa workers also exceeded forty or fifty thousand.

units.source_text: 然而在这个国家每天读早报，却从未见过“罢工”这个词。

en.t: Yet in this country, although I read the morning newspaper every day, I had never once seen the word strike.

units.source_text: 我觉得额很是奇怪，有一回应邀跟培卟和查喀等一起到嘎尔家吃晚饭时，就问起这个事情的原因。

en.t: I found this very strange, and once, when I was invited to Gael's house for dinner together with Pepp, Chak, and the others, I asked about the reason for it.
